title: Autoplay recorder does not track upgrade spending, causing gold_earned=0
detail: In controller.go, the ActionUpgrade case (lines 218-225) does not call recorder.OnTowerBuilt() to track the 10-gold upgrade cost. The formula goldEarned = state.Gold - waveGoldStart + waveGoldSpent produces 0 or negative (clamped to 0) when upgrades consume gold that is not tracked. Greedy strategy shifts to pure upgrades at wave 4+, causing waves 4-12 to report gold_earned=0 and gold_spent=0.

metrics.random_sessions: not affected (random builds towers more often)

suggested_fix.description: In the ActionUpgrade case (line 218), add a call to track the upgrade cost: after the existing for loop that records the anomaly (line 220-224), add `c.recorder.OnTowerBuilt(tower.StrengthBuyCost)` to record the 10-gold upgrade spending. Import tower package if not already imported. This ensures waveGoldSpent includes both build and upgrade costs.

fix_result.description: Added c.recorder.OnTowerBuilt(10) call in the ActionUpgrade case after the anomaly recording loop, so upgrade spending is tracked in wave gold statistics.
fix_result.diff_summary: controller.go: +1 line c.recorder.OnTowerBuilt(10) after upgrade anomaly recording
